name: Ammiel
overview: The name Ammiel appears in Scripture as a figure connected to multiple individuals of significance. He is identified as the father of Machir, who resided in Lodebar, as seen in 2 Samuel 9:4-5 where King David seeks out Machir's household. Additionally, Ammiel is noted as one of the twelve spies from the tribe of Dan, specifically named as the son of Gemalli in Numbers 13:12. This highlights Ammiel’s presence in both the leadership and family lines within Israel’s history.
